title: God’s Plan for Us
verse: Then the man and his wife heard the sound of the Lord God moving about in the orchard at the breezy time of the day, and they hid from the Lord God among the trees of the orchard.
observation: I heard someone once say that all of the Bible from Genesis 4 through Revelation 22 is an effort to bring people back to Genesis 3:8. There was a time when people spent their days caring for the things God had made and spent time with God Himself every evening. There was an innocent, beautiful closeness that was enjoyed. When sin came in, all that was destroyed. The rest of the Bible is God’s effort to redeem His creation and bring us back to this place of joy.
application: Have you thought about how we can “fellowship” with God now because of what Christ has done? What if you took a walk with the Lord today?
prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for giving us the chance to know You by washing away our sin.
